question:
Select the most appropriate synonym for the highlighted word.

There were a **plethora **of options available to the applicant.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Excess."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Plethora means a large or excessive amount of something. (अत्यधिक)
 
 
• Example: The internet offers a plethora of information on almost every subject.
